narrative.overview: Confident, direct and expressive. Dark surfaces, signal red, sharp edges, existing fonts and moving connections communicate the studio's creative character around clear client decisions.

rules.name: Useful connections
rules.body: Connections acknowledge service discovery or native checkbox selection. They never carry the only copy or interaction.

rules.name: Visible by default
rules.body: Keep readable content and project imagery in the prerendered document.

rules.name: Honest examples
rules.body: Use approved reference wording without added demo labels; preserve internal example classification and do not infer verified evidence.

rules.name: Brief before diagram on mobile
rules.body: Place the enquiry form before the selection diagram on narrow layouts, preserving the direct email alternative.

rules.name: Creative motion with control
rules.body: Preserve moving points and service motifs; all cases and Next share the reference Loop viewport curtain. Keep one demand-driven frame scheduler and pause ambient effects offscreen, hidden or behind a dialog. Respect device reduction and the synchronized pause toggles.
